{"S01":"Create a set of counters suitable for use as a 12-hour clock (with am/pm indicator).","S02":"Your counters are clocked by a fast-running clk, with a pulse on ena whenever your clock should increment (i.e., once per second, while \"clk\" is much faster than once per second).","S03":"The signal \"pm\" is asserted if the clock is PM, or is otherwise AM. hh, mm, and ss are two BCD (Binary-Coded Decimal) digits each for hours (01-12), minutes (00-59), and seconds (00-59).","S04":"Reset is the active high synchronous signal that resets the clock to \"12:00 AM.\" Reset has higher priority than enable and can occur even when not enabled."}

integer value is the packed BCD byte, valid states 0x01 through 0x12 representing 01 through 12","update_time":"posedge clk after reset/ena priority","update_during_reset":true},{"name":"mm","meaning":"packed BCD minute; integer value is the packed BCD byte, valid states 0x00 through 0x59","update_time":"posedge clk after reset/ena priority","update_during_reset":true},{"name":"ss","meaning":"packed BCD second; integer value is the packed BCD byte, valid states 0x00 through 0x59","update_time":"posedge clk after reset/ena priority","update_during_reset":true}],"rules":[{"id":"R_RESET","outputs":["pm","hh","mm","ss"],"condition":"reset == 1","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":3,"spec_quote":"Reset is the active high synchronous signal","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"reset":1,"ena":0},{"reset":1,"ena":1}],"expected":[{"pm":0,"hh":18,"mm":0,"ss":0},{"pm":0,"hh":18,"mm":0,"ss":0}]}},{"id":"R_UPDATE","outputs":["pm","hh","mm","ss"],"condition":"reset == 0;
